name: Breeze Canna PRO Disposable | Pink Burst
description: Enjoy a delightful burst of sweet and tangy flavors reminiscent of your favorite pink candy treat. Enhanced with beta caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene terpenes, this playful blend brings happy, relaxed, and uplifted feelings that make every puff feel like a celebration.
